title: Ashbury Rewards Points Commerce Note: Hold on Purchased Points
content:
**Note.** Ashbury Rewards points a member has bought are held back from the transferable balance — the points the member can give to another member — for a purchased-points hold period set by the tier. At the upper tiers the period is shorter: no months for a member at Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite, and one month for a member at Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite or Platinum Elite. Members at Ashbury Rewards Member or Silver Elite have no shortened hold period under this note.

The points held back are those bought in that many months before the handling date. A period of months before the handling date covers the transactions posted after the same day number that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date. A period of no months holds nothing back.

| Tier | Purchased-points hold period |
|---|---|
| Titanium Elite, Ambassador Elite | None — no purchased points are held back |
| Gold Elite, Platinum Elite | 1 month |
| Member, Silver Elite | No shortened hold under this note |

**Illustration (hypothetical members, handling date 20 August 2026).** A Gold Elite member who bought 5000 points on 25 July 2026 and 3000 points on 15 July 2026 has the 5000 points held back (posted after 20 July 2026) and not the 3000. An Ambassador Elite member who bought points yesterday has none of them held back.
